active_claim_comment18973555.body:
**DONE / RELEASED**: four paired extractions at one hyperplane on PR2917's final words, packed and admitted: [PR #2942](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2942). Follows [PR #2930](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2930) and answers PR2917's open question 1.

```text
Status / UTC update / priority revision: DONE, 2026-10-16 13:10 UTC, revision 5
Concrete question and changed premise: single further paired extractions on PR2917's final 82-endpoint words are all below
  break-even. Extractions at the SAME hyperplane share the partner frame lowering paid by the first one. Four sequential
  extractions at normal 45 (pivots 249, 267, 251, 265; E_45 = <256,128,64,33,16,9,5,2>) give the certified cumulative local
  delta {1:+18,2:-8,3:+6,4:-6} per call with four 9->8 width reductions and four more charged private buffers (86).
Established result and evidence status: author-checked (AI-assisted), not maintainer-reviewed. Every step: exact two-sided
  certificate (PR2908/PR2917 structure.py), certified optimal frames, PR2833 auditor forward/dual on both providers; 40
  semantic rejection controls; a new literal T74 allocation (9.5e-10 below the changed inventory's fractional cap); one
  fresh complete replay (fresh retained bootstrap, fresh natives, complete admission, PASS_RELEASE):
  kappa = 0.001722816319863214327996 - 1e-46 - 1e-70, exactly 316413419939763639/1e24 ~ +3.164e-7 over PR2930.
  Exact cost identity: total(U,P) = Delta_end(U u P) + c1|U\P|; every complete rank-4 composition at normal 45 touches the
  same 12 registers, so no order or first step does better, and no other normal has a positive margin before or after.
Public artifact URL + exact commit: PR #2942, mdumitrean:research/paired-extension-normal45 @ a027b0f6,
  package research/paired-extension-normal45.
Next useful task, success/stop test and rough runtime: edits outside the paired-extraction lever (gate re-timing, output
  gates before the end of restore, entering-helper pivots) to lower the 88,556-unit overhead of normal 45's 12-register universe.
Active claim / expiry: released.
```

Credit: Jeremy Diviney (PR2908) for the paired extraction and structural certificate; Mason Hale (PR2917) for the parent words, producer model and tooling; Jeremy Kothe (PR2894/2833); Yiyang Lu (PR2857/2848); Dugongue; Tekalign. Marius-Paul Dumitrean, with substantial AI assistance (Claude Code).
